what: Triage of the reading sweep's repair-candidate notes on ACTIVE records (2026-10-15). In scope (ruling 2026-10-15: "broken, missing, and mislabelled files / and citations"; "the focus is on active, non-duplicate records"): damage done by the archive's handling — conversion (in:conversion), seating (in:seating: wrong, truncated, missing bodies), duplicate bodies (in:duplicate), record metadata disagreeing with the deposit's own text (in:label), broken links and images (in:links), referenced attachments not seated or linked (in:attachments). Out of scope: the text as published — DOIs and versions cited inside the text, the deposit's own figures, placeholders and stubs published as such, contradictions between deposits. ruling:pending-doi: in-text "[pending]" DOIs that were later assigned — for a ruling. Rule-sorted, then 86 notes read by hand and 45 out-of-scope notes spot-checked.
